using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.server;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class ServerConfigTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void NetworkCONFIG_SET_LogsWarning_WhenClusterPasswordProvidedWithoutUsername()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();
        var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>(); // Assuming interface exists or needs refactor
        mockStoreWrapper.SetupGet(x => x.clusterProvider).Returns((IClusterProvider)null);

        var session = new TestableRespServerSession(mockLogger.Object, mockStoreWrapper.Object);

        // Simulate CONFIG SET cluster-password "pass"
        session.parseState.Add(new MockRespArg("cluster-password"));
        session.parseState.Add(new MockRespArg("pass"));

        // Act
        var result = session.CallNetworkCONFIG_SET();

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<EventId>(), 
                It.Is<It.IsAny<string>>((v, t) => t == "Cluster username is not provided, will use new password with existing username"),
                It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NetworkCONFIG_SET_ProcessesUnknownOption_WithoutLoggingWarning()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();

        var session = new TestableRespServerSession(mockLogger.Object, null);

        // Simulate CONFIG SET unknownkey "value"
        session.parseState.Add(new MockRespArg("unknownkey"));
        session.parseState.Add(new MockRespArg("value"));

        // Act
        var result = session.CallNetworkCONFIG_SET();

        // Assert - no warning should be logged for unknown option processing
        mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAny<string>>(), It.IsAny<object[]>(), It.IsAny<Exception>()), Times.Never);
    }
}

// Test helpers - these would need to match the actual internal structure
public class TestableRespServerSession : RespServerSession
{
    public List<MockRespArg> parseState = new();

    public TestableRespServerSession(ILogger<RespServerSession> logger, IStoreWrapper storeWrapper)
    {
        // Initialize with minimal required fields for the test
        this.logger = logger;
        this.storeWrapper = storeWrapper;
    }

    public bool CallNetworkCONFIG_SET()
    {
        return this.NetworkCONFIG_SET();
    }
}

public class MockRespArg
{
    private readonly string _data;
    public MockRespArg(string data) => _data = data;
    public ReadOnlySpan<byte> ReadOnlySpan => System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(_data);
    public ReadOnlySpan<byte> Span => ReadOnlySpan;
}

// Placeholder interfaces - would need actual types or refactor
public interface IStoreWrapper 
{
    IClusterProvider? clusterProvider { get; }
    ServerOptions serverOptions { get; }
}

public interface IClusterProvider 
{
    void UpdateClusterAuth(string username, string password);
    void FlushConfig();
}
